notes.title: Update for New Players
notes.content:
Hello, inventors!

I’ve noticed a trend when players dive into Temporian and share their adventures. Many jump right into the game on normal, hard, or even brutal difficulty, skip the tutorial, and later feel lost or find the game too challenging.

Since Temporian’s release a year ago, I’ve been on a mission to make the start smoother for everyone by:

[list]
[*] Streamlining the tutorial
[*] Emphasizing Easy Mode for beginners
[*] Introducing automatic recipe updates
[*] Simplifying idea generation for characters
[*] Producing how-to-play videos
[*] Offering extra lifelines to prevent instant game overs
[/list]

The heart of Temporian is discovery, and the tutorial is there to cover the basics like card stacking and crafting. After that, it’s all about exploring and learning at your own pace. Some may click with it right away, while others might take a bit longer, and that’s perfectly okay!

To ensure everyone gets the most out of their first journey in Temporian, I’ve made a change. New adventurers will start on Easy mode with the tutorial guiding them. Once you’ve triumphed or met your untimely end, all difficulty levels will unlock for your next playthrough.

I hope this enhances your experience without impacting our seasoned players. If it does, I’m all ears for your feedback. Happy gaming!

notes.title: Update Notes for March 9th
notes.content:
What's New in Temporian:

[list]
[*] Font Update: We changed the game's font. It looks nicer now, so everything's easier to read and looks better.
[*] Family Feature: Now, if two of your workers share a house, they can start a family! It adds a cool new twist to how you manage your people, just don't expect them to do much for a long time!
[*] New Foods: We've hidden some fun new foods in the game for you to discover, like fries. Who doesn't love finding new snacks, right?
[*] Eating Seeds: You can eat seeds now, and we keep them with the other foods that need cooking. It's a small change but makes things more organized.
[*] Easier Start: For those playing on Easy mode, we've made it even better. You can start with up to 100 cards now, giving you more options from the get-go.
[*] Turn Counter: There's a new turn counter on the screen, so you always know which turn you're on. Handy, right?
[*] Easy Mode Hint: We added a note to suggest new players start on Easy mode. It's a great way to get the hang of things.
[*] No More Losing Books: You can't put the research book in the Temporian in Easy mode anymore. Even I do it by mistake from time to time, so beginners might not realise what's happened.
[*] New Art: We've added some beautiful new artwork for the story events, making those moments even more special.
[*] Shelter Reminder: We've made it clearer that your people need shelters, not just to be told they're cold. It's more about SNOWING, not telling.
[/list]

Fixes:

Bug Squash: We fixed a bug where if you CTRL-Clicked a card not in the Research Book, it would take you to a blank page. No more getting lost in the game!

Hope you enjoy these updates and have even more fun playing Temporian!

notes.title: Version 1.0.8
notes.content:
Another update which will hopefully make things easier for players that are new to the game.

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Easy Mode research will now carry over to future Easy Mode games
[*] Cards stored in the Temporian are now difficulty and profile locked, meaning, for example, you can't transfer a research book from Easy to Hard
[*] Unlock cards cost fewer points
[*] Unlock points are no longer earned each turn. Instead you earn a fixed amount for completing a run, so long as it's longer than 5 years
[*] Unlock points are no longer earned in easy mode
[*] The harder the difficulty, the more research points you'll earn upon completion
[*] Chinese font updated
[*] Japanese font updated
[/list]

Please let me know if you spot any issues, and I will get right on them.

notes.title: Release Version 1.0.6
notes.content:
Quite a few changes and additions were added to this build, so let's break them down.

[list]
[*] The Chinese Version was retranslated by Everqueen! Thanks for that!
[*] The Research Book has been changed so pages are sorted by category and then alphabetically.
[*] The Research Book has been updated to allow players to type on their keyboard, and it will search for what you're typing in.
[*] If you press the CTRL key while on the board, the cursor will change to a magnifying glass. Ctrl-Click on a card to go straight to that page in the research book.
[*] A symbol has been added to the Year so it's easier to know the current season.
[*] Full screen is no longer toggled by the esc key. You can find a new option in the options menu.
[*] The Esc key will now close the research book and will exit to the main menu from the board.
[*] Clay can now be found from the river.
[/list]

Please let me know your thoughts on these changes, as well as if you find any bugs!

Enjoy

notes.title: Version 1.0 is Coming!
notes.content:
Dear Valued Players,

I hope you've been enjoying your journey as Temporian is developed and refined. I have a couple of important updates to share.

First, [b]in approximately one month, I'll be releasing Version 1.0[/b], a major milestone! Compared to Temporian's initial Early Access release, this version includes many changes and additions that I'm proud to share with you:
[list]
[*] Gameplay Mechanics and Functionality: I've made critical adjustments to gameplay descriptions and mechanics for an even more immersive experience.
[*] New Additions: New elements such as custom card storage, additional cards, and many more exciting features.
[*] Functionality Improvements: Enhancements like better ways to fast-forward and improved sorting in the recipe book have been implemented for a smoother gameplay experience, and taking single cards from stacks.
[*] Visual and Audio Enhancements: Toggle weather effects and smoother music transitions.
[*] Balancing Changes: Based on your feedback, I've rebalanced the game to ensure a fair and enjoyable experience for everyone.
[*] Bug Fixes: Numerous bugs have been fixed, resulting in increased stability and overall enjoyment of the game.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43300775/86e8779355c2779c0a5be2add4601841330a45c4.png[/img]

[i]A more expansive list is below this announcement.[/i]

Along with 1.0's release, Scenarios will finally be included in the game. Scenarios will allow players to unlock new cards, as well as try their hand at the game with different starting conditions, new events, and challenging restrictions.

Second, in alignment with my initial plans to reflect the value of these substantial updates, and as mentioned in the Early Access notes on the store page, [b]I will be adjusting the price of the game from $8.99 to $14.99[/b]. This change will come into effect on May 30th, aligning with Steam's pricing policies.

I understand that price changes can be a sensitive subject. It's essential to note that this decision wasn't made lightly. The initial reduced price was my way of thanking early adopters who supported me and helped shape the game through their valuable feedback.

If you've been thinking about joining our community, you can still purchase the game at the Early Access price of $8.99 for the next three days. To celebrate the full release, I'm also planning a special launch day discount - giving you one more chance to get the game at a reduced rate before the new price takes full effect.

Once again, thank you for your support and understanding. I can't wait for you to experience Version 1.0!

Additionally, I'd like to share that I firmly believe in delivering true value to you. This is why I'm not a fan of paid DLCs - I want the game to grow organically and be accessible to all of you who have supported me on this journey. That's why I'm committing to adding free content updates to the game, even after we reach Version 1.0.

So, rest assured, the launch of 1.0 is not the end - far from it. It's just the beginning of a new chapter in our adventure together, one filled with exciting new additions and enhancements that I can't wait for you to experience. Your journey in our game world will continue to evolve and expand.

Thanks again for your amazing support.

[h1]Changes[/h1]

1. Gameplay Mechanics and Functionality:

Adjustments to gameplay descriptions and mechanics
New feature: ability to turn off various weather and zoom effects
Improved fast-forward functionality
Enhanced bookmark features in the recipe book
Added the ability to end your turn using the space bar

2. Balancing and Adjustments:

Balancing of food lifespan
Rebalancing of resource generation and usage
Adjustments to morale management, including new visuals to indicate health and morale status

3. Visual and Audio Enhancements:

Updated visual effects for snow for more immersion
Changes to game speed synchronization across different hardware
Music transitions now fade in and out smoothly

4. Multiplayer Updates:

Enhanced multiplayer functionality, reducing wait times for friends
Ability to send a queue of resources to a friend through the Temporian
Multiplayer limit increased to 8 players

5. New Additions:

New recipes and buildings: Sawmill, Watchtower, Telescope, Greenhouses
Addition of new resources: Glass, Potatoes
Introduction of new secret elements to the game

6. Bug Fixes:

Multiple bug fixes addressing character behavior, visual glitches, incorrect descriptions and more
Notable fixes include resolution of infinite character death loop and cheat code deactivation

7. Quality of Life Improvements:

Enhanced recipe book with filters and quick-check option
Improved in-game card management and labeling system
Ability to quickly locate workers by hovering over the Housing button

This is just a brief overview of the major changes. We're excited for you to explore them all. Your continuous support and feedback have been invaluable in helping us refine and enrich our game.

[h3]Beta #1[/h3]
[list]
[*] Vineyards also turn into fields when they are used up now, just like farms.

[*] Added glass as a new recipe. This will open quite a few doors, I'm not sure I'm ready to go down

[/list]

[h3]Beta #2[/h3]
[list]
[*] Corrected the sawmill recipe, so it now allows you to actually research it

[list]

[*] Cow and Pig "Corpses" have been changed to "Carcass"... so it doesn't sound so morbid

[olist]

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] You weren't able to research Potatoes - Fixed
[*] Sometimes, carrots were set as raw, rather than food - Fixed
[*] Pie quantities have been reduced. A chef will now only make 1 more pie than any other cook
[/list]

As mentioned, this new build extends the endgame slightly, meaning you will need to work more with metals.

As always, feedback is greatly appreciated!

notes.title: Stable Update Incoming
notes.content:
I've been working on the beta version for the past 2 weeks, and I've gathered a lot of valuable information, as well as made several big changes!

[h2]This is just a message to let you know that tomorrow's update will render your current saves incompatible.[/h2]

Therefore, if you're in the middle of a game, please finish it before updating.

[h3]The patch will be released at 18:00 GMT.[/h3]

I'm glad to see so many of you enjoying the game. With this update, the endgame has been extended close to where I aim for it to be in the final release, as well as introducing several new cards.

We still have some way to go, but I can now start unlocking the Scenario mode over the next couple of weeks. I'm excited to share more information about this, but will save that for a future message.

Finally, I just want to emphasise that while we're still in Early Access there will be no discount or price drop. I don't think it's fair to offer a discount to others after you've all kindly helped me improve the game.

[h1]Saying that, as mentioned in the Early Access notes on the Store page, when the game is fully released, the price will be increased by an amount that's still to be determined.

There are thousands of people who have wishlisted the game, and I just want to make sure they don't miss out on the current low price.[/h1]

If you happen to know of someone who has wishlisted the game, please let them know.

As always, thank you for your support, it means more than you know.

Alright... back to inventing!

notes.title: Beta Branch
notes.content:
To avoid what happened today, regarding old saves being incompatible, I'm going to be creating a new branch of builds.

The stable build, and the beta build.

You're all welcome to gain access to the beta build, which will include all of the latest features and updates.

Once I'm happy with the build, I'll be publishing it as a stable build. Hopefully on a weekly basis.

I can't apologise enough for releasing a build that breaks your saves without warning. I know a lot of you put in a great deal of time, and having that simply taken away is beyond disappointing.

Hopefully, I've learned from my mistake, and having this beta build will stop that from being an issue in the future.

[h3]How to Join[/h3]

If you'd like to join the beta build, please right click Temporian in your Steam Library, select manage, select the beta tab and input the password "[b]temporianbeta[/b]".

This will unlock the beta branch.

I don't imagine we'll have another save incompatibility glitch, but it's better to be safe than sorry.

[*] Some languages have had their translations updated. Thanks to 김길용 for help with the Korean translation.
[*] You can now quickly find out where your workers are by hovering over the Housing button at the top.
[*] New toggle in Options will allow you to set the game to always run at a faster speed during the processing stage, without needing to hold down the spacebar or mouse button. Please note, this will make it hard to see what's going on.
[*] Hopefully fixed the multiplayer bug with the Steam name not appearing, but the only way to test it is on Steam.
[*] Added a new secret to the game. Let me know if you find it ;)
[/list]

Haven't seen too many bugs again with the last build, so the next will likely also be able to have new features!

If you have any ideas, as always, please share them! And if you're enjoying the game so far, please consider giving it a review! It really helps out!

notes.title: Changelog #5
notes.content:
Changes:

[list]
[*] Changed multiplayer from turn-based to real time. You no longer have to wait for each other to finish. Play as you want, even if they're offline. They can join whenever they want.
[*] You're now able to send a queue of resources to your friend through the Temporian.
[*] Friend's Steam name should now appear.
[*] Food has been balanced a little more.
[*] Leader can now still research alone after forming the school.
[*] Logs are no longer super fuels (Sorry Jester!)
[*] Added a new secret to the game.
[/list]

Things appear to be more stable this week than last week, so it might be time to start adding new buildings and extending the length of the game.
So far, I have planned:

[list]
[*] A sawmill, which will allow you to cut multiple logs at the same time.
[*] A workbench which will allow you to disassemble items back into their base components.
[/list]

[list]
[*] I'm currently planning and researching methods of creating batteries, as I'm not a fan of just slapping an electricity card onto the Temporian.
[*] Also researching other methods of creating generators.
[*] Also want to create more ways that electricity can be used.
[/list]

I have to be careful with expanding the game. It's incredibly easy to make a game feel bloated and boring by adding new content.

If you have any ideas, as always, please share them!

notes.title: Changelog #4
notes.content:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Corpses now remain on the board after a death
[*] Corpses don't stay fresh as long anymore
[*] Food lifespan has been rebalanced
[*] Recipe book now has a filter
[*] Recipe book can now be quick-checked via the main board
[*] Food items such as dough, pastry and wheat now have an expiry date and appear in raw food storage
[*] Dough Recipe in book corrected
[*] Farms and Vineyards can be replanted
[*] Farms and Vineyards can be converted
[*] Highlights appear faster, hinting toward recipes
[*] Highlights indicate more recipes than previously
[*] The longer you hold down the button, the faster the game will process the turn. This may break a few things... so let's test this carefully.
[/list]

Achievement for the Realm ending on Brutal has been fixed (hopefully), so START THE RACE!!!

[h2]Trialling:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added in a new icon over workers that will allow you to give them a specialist label. This is subject to change.
[*] Checking to see if rotating farms helps you see the numbers. Obviously, this doesn't help when there's just a worker on it, but with larger farms, this is easier to see.
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog# 3
notes.content:
Changes:

[list]
[*] In Easy Mode, Workers will not turn up if you haven't built them a place to live. This is to prevent over-population.
[*] Added more names to the list of Workers (Thanks for helping!)
[*] Filled in those tiny gaps between words in the recipe book, so you don't click between them, and simply turn the page.
[*] Added an undo button to the bookmark, which will allow you to go back to your previous page.
[*] Changed the bookmark even further, so clicking it will take you back to the contents page you started on, rather than the first page each time.
[*] Added additional information to the first 2 pages of the recipe book, which should help explain a few more features.
[*] Realised I missed a translation :( Sad times...
[*] When you finish the game, it should hopefully unlock previously unlocked achievements if they haven't yet unlocked. Not sure what's going on with this... so it might not be fixed yet :(
[*] Tutorial now appears on all difficulty levels, and is an option if you choose to look more into the Temporian, meaning it's now optional on easy mode.
[*] Fixed multiple bugs in the Tutorial that were locking it.
[*] Delta time has been added to the game, which means it should be running at the same speed for most things now for those with nuclear powered PCs, rather than my hamster-powered PC. This will be further developed in the future.
[*] Traveller's music will now fade in and out, rather than a sudden change.
[*] Forager Specialist can get more apples from a tree, as well as other resources in other seasons.
[*] Logs now boost a fire by 3 rather than 2.
[*] The Expedition recipe has been added to the game, so it can be unlocked correctly.
[*] Batch making... Still in development, but for now you can combine up to 5 water and 5 soil to make 5 clay. It doesn't require a worker, and the previous method simply took up too much space.
[*] Fixed bug where you can grind new cards if they haven't been placed yet.
[/list]

There is a lot more that I'm working on, but as you can tell, there's a lot here, and I need to get some fixes out, so I can start working on other aspects and you don't have to wait too long!

Just wanted to say a massive thank you for the support so far! Keep those ideas and feedback coming. You're the ones improving the game :)

I have some wonderful features planned for the next build. One of which I'm REALLY excited for. It's almost a shame I've put so many secrets in the game XD

If you're enjoying it, please please please take the time to show it some love in the review section. It makes a massive difference to encourage others to give it a try!

Right... back to work for me! Happy Time-Travels!

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
This is a quick hotfix to hopefully fix a few issues people have reported.

[list]
[*] Cows no longer fish... shame, but necessary :(
[*] Gamepad controls are disabled for now, hopefully this will resolve issues with the mouse disappearing
[*] I've added the ability to clear game data from the options menu... artfully crammed into the bottom right. This'll be tidied up later, but for now, it will hopefully allow people who are locked out to start playing again.
[/list]

Hopefully this won't break anything else. I've had to disable some of the new additions I was working on to get this hotfix out quickly, so please let me know if anything random suddenly pops up!

notes.title: Changelog #2
notes.content:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43300775/53a49466bae974c6032229a90fbbc9f3ec20ba20.png[/img]

notes.title: Temporian is LIVE!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Temporian is LIVE!!![/h1]
